profile.headline: Web Developer at Peraton | Crafting engaging and accessible web experiences with design expertise
profile.summary:
As a Lead Associate Web Developer at Peraton, over six years of experience has been dedicated to designing, developing, and maintaining CDC websites like "Tips from Former Smokers" and "Smoking and Tobacco Use." Specializing in web design and compliance with 508 accessibility standards, contributions have supported public health initiatives by ensuring content is user-friendly and accessible. Proficiency in utilizing a proprietary WCMS, coupled with strong client collaboration, has enabled seamless content updates and impactful site improvements.  

Prior to Peraton, worked as a Senior Web Developer at Northrop Grumman, delivering consistent results in creating and optimizing CDC's public-facing websites. Known for balancing independent tasks with collaborative teamwork, the focus remains on delivering high-quality, accessible, and relevant user experiences. Committed to leveraging technical expertise and creative problem-solving to advance organizational goals and enhance digital accessibility for diverse audiences.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Web Developer for the CDC | Office on Smoking and Health - Tips from Former Smokers and Smoking and Tobacco Use websites.

Overview: 
    •  Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Tips from Former Smokers and Smoking and Tobacco Use websites using proprietary WCMS (Content Management System) while applying current agency and team standards, including 508 compliancy; develop applicable documentation for projects and tasks.

    •  Work with client to ensure content remains updated and relevant; provide suggestions and plans for site improvement; submit content for Quality Assurance.
    
    •   Perform tasks independently, as well as collaboratively, within a close team environment.

positions.title: Front-end Developer and Graphic Designer
positions.description: I work on a contract basis to provide high-quality web development and print design services to corporations, small businesses, and individual clients, including: 3dMD, Georgia Tech Research Institute, The Andrew J. Young Foundation, theAnvel.com, ADVA-Tec, Inc., Little Mammoth Media, VanDerKloot Film & Television, Advanced Color Imaging and totallycustomwallpapers.com, Kudzu Arts Zone, Splash Festivals, Norcross Arts Alliance, CopyKat Recipes, Atlanta Interfaith Broadcasters (AIB), TonyTeach.com, Miss Universe Ghana

positions.title: Sr. Graphic Designer
positions.description: Provided graphic solutions for a broad spectrum of Woodruff Arts Center Administration projects (principally projects for the CEO, VPs, and Directors); Coordinated with the IT Department to design, develop, and implement the main Woodruff Arts Center website. Also worked as co-webmaster on the site; developed and maintained branding initiatives and lent graphic support to creative counterparts throughout Woodruff’s member divisions (high museum of Art, Atlanta symphony Orchestra, Alliance Theatre, and Atlanta College of Art). Required to be self-sufficient, pro-active, and able to work effectively as a key member of the creative team as well as a frequent consultant and contributor to the design efforts of Woodruff’s Public Relations and Initiatives Department on a vast array of projects.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: Taught computer graphics, desktop publishing and computer orientation. Responsibilities included curriculum design and planning, tutorial development, syllabus/course design and implementation, education and mentoring. Designed a one-day computer orientation model, implemented by ACA in Fall 2002, which became a required prerequisite for all freshmen and transfer students
